lead.titleZh: 急性间歇性低氧或可改善多发性硬化症躯体运动功能：一项 RCT
lead.titleEn: Acute Intermittent Hypoxia May Improve Somatic Motor Function in MS: An RCT
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 6 条更新，涵盖 4 个专科。神经康复领域有 3 条值得关注，其中一项 RCT 信号最强，提示 5 天急性间歇性低氧对多发性硬化症患者安全且或可改善躯体运动功能，curatedScore 达 80 分。此外，行业与执业方面也有重要政策更新。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's update includes 6 items across 4 specialties. In neurological rehabilitation, 3 items are notable, with the strongest signal from an RCT indicating that five days of acute intermittent hypoxia is safe and may improve somatic motor function in persons with multiple sclerosis, with a curatedScore of 80. Additionally, there are important policy updates in the 'Industry and Practice' category.

items.title: The MSK Playbook: Hamstring Strain Injuries - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: A BJSM blog post reviews hamstring strain injuries, which account for 24% of all professional football injuries, with recurrence rates exceeding 30%. The article explores injury mechanisms, biomechanics, imaging use, and rehab protocols, emphasizing the complex challenges in management.
items.curatedReason: 这篇指南性文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤的损伤机制、成像应用和康复方案，强调了这种常见运动损伤的高复发率。它提醒你评估和管理腘绳肌拉伤需要全面考虑生物力学、神经学和心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: MSK 剧本：腘绳肌拉伤 - BJSM 博客 - 社交媒体领先的运动医学之声。
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤，这种损伤占所有职业足球损伤的24%，复发率超过30%。文章探讨了损伤机制、生物力学、影像学应用和康复方案，强调了管理中的复杂挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guidance article reviews hamstring strain injury mechanisms, imaging applications, and rehabilitation protocols, highlighting the high recurrence rate of this common sports injury. It reminds you that assessing and managing hamstring strains requires a holistic consideration of biomechanical, neurological, and psychosocial factors.

items.title: Five Days of Acute Intermittent Hypoxia Is Safe and Improves Somatic Motor Function in Persons with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled crossover trial (n=23 MS patients) found that 5 days of acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) significantly increased ankle plantarflexion torque (beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001) and 6-minute walk distance (beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039) compared to Sham, with no serious adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照交叉试验显示，每日急性间歇性低氧（AIH）对多发性硬化症（MS）患者是安全且耐受的，并能显著改善踝关节跖屈力量和步行耐力。你可考虑将AIH作为增强MS患者神经可塑性和康复效果的辅助手段，特别是在结合特定任务步态训练时。
items.titleZh: 五天急性间歇性低氧对多发性硬化症患者安全且可改善躯体运动功能。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验（n=23名MS患者）发现，与假治疗相比，为期5天的急性间歇性低氧（AIH）显著增加了踝关节跖屈扭矩（beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001）和6分钟步行距离（beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039），且未报告严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled crossover trial shows that daily acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) is safe and well-tolerated in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS) and significantly improves ankle plantarflexion strength and walking endurance. You may consider AIH as an adjunct to enhance neuroplasticity and rehabilitation outcomes in MS patients, especially when combined with task-specific gait training.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（23名患者），且随访时间有限，长期效果尚待确认。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (23 patients) and limited follow-up duration, with long-term effects yet to be confirmed.

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A single-arm pilot study with 9 participants (7 stroke, 1 Parkinson's) found oropharyngeal alignment exercise feasible and well-tolerated, with most showing increased maximal mouth opening (6-13 mm) and statistically significant improvements in MASA, GUSS, and PAS scores, particularly for semisolid boluses.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，口咽对齐训练在有吞咽困难和口部张开受限的神经系统疾病患者中是可行且耐受性良好的。如果你的患者也有类似症状，可以留意后续更大规模的对照试验。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐训练对伴口张受限的神经系统疾病患者吞咽功能的可行性及初步效果：一项预试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对9名参与者（7名卒中，1名帕金森病）进行的单臂预试验发现，口咽对齐训练可行且耐受性良好，大多数参与者最大口张开度增加6-13毫米，MASA、GUSS和PAS评分统计学显著改善，尤其对半固体团块效果明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study indicates that oropharyngeal alignment exercise is feasible and well-tolerated in neurological patients with dysphagia and restricted mouth opening. If your patients present with similar symptoms, keep an eye on future larger-scale controlled trials.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂先导研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组，无法推断干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm pilot study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing causal inference of the intervention's effects.

items.title: Unpacking the Success: An Ecological Systems Perspective on Distance Running Performance in Ethiopia
items.summary: A mixed-methods study (n=145 Ethiopian distance runners) found that primary education level (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) were significant quantitative predictors of high performance. Qualitative themes highlighted hardship, community support, and the balance between tradition and modernization in training.
items.curatedReason: 想培养高水平长跑运动员，别只盯着生理指标。这项针对埃塞俄比亚跑者的观察研究提示，初等教育（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是重要的表现预测因子。更重要的是，社区支持和社会经济背景等宏观因素可能同样关键。
items.titleZh: 剖析成功：从生态系统视角看埃塞俄比亚长跑表现 | Sports Medicine - Open。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究（n=145名埃塞俄比亚长跑运动员）发现，小学教育水平（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是高水平表现的显著定量预测因子。定性主题强调了训练中的艰辛、社区支持以及传统与现代化的平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't just focus on physiological metrics for high-performance distance runners. This observational study on Ethiopian runners suggests primary education (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) are significant predictors. Crucially, macro factors like community support and socioeconomic background may be just as vital.
items.limitation: 研究采用混合方法，但量化部分为观察性，结果存在潜在混杂因素，且模型外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study used a mixed-methods approach, but the quantitative section is observational, with potential confounders and limited generalizability of the models.

items.title: Final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Has Mixed Payment Impact for Physical Therapy
items.summary: APTA reports on CMS's final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule, noting a mixed impact for physical therapy. CMS reduced conversion factors, but secured yearly payment increases for top-billed PT codes for the next several years.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了2027年医师收费标准最终规则，对物理治疗师而言，虽然转换因子有所下调，但高频PT代码在未来几年将获得年度支付增长。你需要仔细研究具体代码的费率调整，以优化你的报销策略。
items.titleZh: 2027年医师收费标准最终规则对物理治疗的支付影响喜忧参半 | APTA。
items.summaryZh: APTA 报道了 CMS 发布的2027年医师收费标准最终规则，指出对物理治疗有喜忧参半的影响。CMS 下调了转换因子，但确保了未来几年高频物理治疗代码的年度支付增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule. For physical therapists, while conversion factors are reduced, top-billed PT codes will see annual payment increases over the next few years. You need to meticulously review the specific code adjustments to optimize your reimbursement strategy.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - CEO update to the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum
items.summary: Ahpra's CEO, Justin Untersteiner, addressed the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum, discussing how the growing health workforce (approaching one million registered practitioners) and evolving care delivery models, including AI, necessitate agile regulation. He emphasized vigilance against emerging risks, particularly conflicts of interest in commercial arrangements that may influence clinical decisions.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 的 CEO 强调，随着监管专业人数接近百万，新兴商业模式和AI技术带来新的执业风险，尤其关注可能影响临床决策的利益冲突。作为在澳大利亚执业的PT，你应特别留意更新后的行为准则和监管机构对利益冲突的指导意见。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 - CEO 向 RACS 外科领导者论坛更新。
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）首席执行官 Justin Untersteiner 在 RACS 外科领导者论坛上发表讲话，讨论了随着医疗从业人员数量接近百万，新兴的医疗服务模式（包括人工智能）如何要求灵活的监管。他强调了对新兴风险的警惕，尤其是商业安排中可能影响临床决策的利益冲突。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CEO of the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) highlighted new practice risks from emerging business models and AI technology as the number of regulated professionals approaches one million, with a particular focus on conflicts of interest that could influence clinical decision-making. As a PT practicing in Australia, you should pay close attention to the updated codes of conduct and regulatory guidance on conflicts of interest.
